settings.hero_desc: A striking pyramid award in navy and gold, engraved with your award and recipient. A modern, substantial trophy for leadership programmes, regional awards and milestone recognition.
settings.s1_body: A pyramid commands attention - solid, balanced and symbolic of achievement. This award pairs a navy body with a gold apex and an engraved face naming the award and recipient. A contemporary, substantial trophy for leadership awards, regional recognition and programme milestones - produced as a single piece or a coordinated set.
settings.case_body: Created for a leadership recognition programme, this pyramid award gave the milestone a fitting symbol - a modern, substantial trophy that winners proudly displayed in their offices.
settings.case_quote: A beautiful, weighty award. It looks the part on stage and takes pride of place afterwards.
settings.prov_p: The pyramid has symbolised accomplishment for millennia. As an award, it gives recognition a form that feels as significant as the achievement itself.
